# AORUS ELITE P850W 80+ Platinum Modular PCIe 5.1 ICE (Rev. 2.0)

Rev. 2.0 Rev. 1.0 Rev. 1.1

GP-AE850PM PG5 ICE

## Key Features

 

 

### FEATURES 

- ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 ready 
- 80 PLUS and Cybenetics Platinum efficiency 
- 100% Japanese capacitors 
- 120mm smart Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan 
- Cybenetics LAMBDA A++ certified 
- Compact design 
- Fully modular design 
- Powerful single +12V rail 
- OVP/OPP/SCP/UVP/OCP/OTP/NLO/SIP protection 
- 10 years warranty (Adjusted according to different regions) 

 

 

### ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 ready 

 The AE850PM PG5 ICE can sustain power excursions of up to 3 times the GPU power and 2 times the total power. It's fully compliant with the Intel ATX 3.1 standard, supporting up to 200% power excursions and achieving 70% efficiency at low loads. Additionally, the included high-quality, native 16-pin cable ensures compatibility with PCIe Gen 5 graphics cards, delivering up to 600 watts of power. 

 

 TOTAL POWER EXCURSION

...

### Silent by Design 

 A high-performance 120mm smart Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan delivers quiet, long-lasting operation and remains off under low loads (below 50%), achieving Cybenetics-certified near-silent performance below 20 dBA. 

### Compact design 

 GIGABYTE's engineering expertise in heat dissipation and material selection has shrunk the length of the power supply to an impressive 140 mm, ensuring compatibility with even space-constrained chassis. 

 

### Fully Modular Design 

 Embossed modular cables make clean builds effortless. Connect only what’s needed to reduce clutter, optimize airflow, and unlock better thermal performance inside the chassis. 

 

### Powerful single +12V rail 

 Single +12V rail provides the best power output, stability and compatibility for the hardware. It provides the easiest way to install the power cable. And it is the best design for overclocking.

### ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 ready

 TOTAL POWER EXCURSION

...

### 80 PLUS Platinum certified 

 80 Plus Platinum certified ensures to deliver 92% efficiency at 50% load. The better power efficiency leads to less power waste, less heat and less fan noise. 

 

### 100% Japanese capacitors 

 All capacitors are high quality Japanese capacitors, to produce the efficient performance and to ensure the longer reliability.

...

### 120mm smart Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan 

 High-performance Fluid Dynamic Bearing fan uses oil film shock absorption technology to effectively reduce noise, making it quieter than conventional sleeve fan and providing more than twice the lifespan. In addition, the fan speed is adjusted according to the automatic power detection and stops when the system is idle or under low load (less than 50% load). 

### Compact design 

 GIGABYTE's engineering expertise in heat dissipation and material selection has shrunk the length of the power supply to an impressive 140 mm, ensuring compatibility with even space-constrained chassis. 

 

### Fully modular design 

 All the flat cables are modular design. Installing only the cables you need to reduce clutter, to increase the airflow and to improve the chassis thermal performance. 

 

### Powerful single +12V rail 

 Single +12V rail provides the best power output, stability and compatibility for the hardware. It provides the easiest way to install the power cable. And it is the best design for overclocking.
